title: Next Day
description: Write code that enhances all date objects such that you can call the `date.nextDay()` method on any date object and it will return the next day in the format *YYYY-MM-DD* as a string.
constraints: new Date(date) is a valid date object
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Next Day.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
